learnings.question: In Islamic theology, which term refers to the actual occurrence and unfolding of events in a person's life that can be influenced or altered by supplication (Dua) and actions?
learnings.learning: Qada’ refers to the actual occurrence and unfolding of events in life, which can be altered through actions and Dua (supplication), while Qadr represents Allah’s complete, preordained plan and eternal knowledge.
learnings.articleTitle: The Art of Qada’ and Qadr

learnings.question: In PCIe power management, which L1 substate specifically powers down the electrical circuits of the main link to achieve greater energy savings than L1.0?
learnings.learning: Within PCIe L1 power-saving states, L1.1 achieves deeper energy savings than L1.0 by specifically powering down the electrical circuits of the main link, resulting in an increased wake-up time.
learnings.articleTitle: Power Management States in the context of PCIe

learnings.question: When analyzing Arabic text, what precision challenge arises from removing Tashkeel (vowel markings) to simplify the dataset?
options: The right-to-left reading order is permanently inverted in tabular displays
The text encoding becomes incompatible with standard JSON and data structures
Different words that share the same letter spelling become indistinguishable
Words can no longer be split and tokenized using standard whitespace delimiters
learnings.learning: While omitting Tashkeel (vowel markings) makes Arabic text simpler and more uniform for data analysis, it sacrifices precision because distinct Arabic words can share the exact same letter spelling when vowel marks are absent.
learnings.articleTitle: Top 20 Words to Understand the Quran: A Data Analysis using Python

learnings.question: Regarding the stewardship role of 'khalifah,' who holds the responsibility for preserving faith and maintaining communal unity?
options: Every individual collectively, rather than appointed leaders alone
Solely historical figures and former prophets
Only the political authorities within a state
learnings.learning: Under the role of khalifah (caretaker), preserving religious teachings and maintaining communal unity is not the exclusive domain of appointed leaders, but a collective responsibility shared by each individual.

learnings.question: Which Scrum artifact is used to visualize the progress of a Sprint and display the remaining work to determine if the team is on schedule?
learnings.learning: In Scrum, a Burndown Chart is an artifact that visualizes the progress of a Sprint by showing remaining work and helping the team track if they are on schedule.
